OSCP Prep Repository

Personal OSCP preparation notes, methodology, and retired-HTB machine writeups, with a small Flask web app to browse everything in one place.

🌐 Live GitHub Pages Site: https://shruthi-poojari.github.io/oscp_learning/

Authorized lab / OSCP learning use only (HTB retired machines, PWK labs, systems you own or are contracted to test).

Repository Layout

.
├── OSCP-Methodology.md       # master methodology, port reference, tool notes, exam checklist
├── Notes/                    # per-topic reference notes
│   ├── Nmap.md   SMB.md   FTP.md   HTTP.md   DNS.md
│   ├── LDAP.md   MSSQL.md WinRM.md PrivEsc.md
│   ├── Metasploit.md  Reverse-Shells.md  File-Transfer.md
├── HTB/                      # retired machine writeups
│   ├── Enigma.md   Lame.md   Legacy.md
│   └── samples/              # reference writeups (see note below)
└── webapp/                   # Flask notes viewer

Running the Web App

The app reads every .md file in this repo and serves it with a grouped sidebar, rendered tables, and syntax-highlighted code blocks.

1. One-time setup

cd webapp
python3 -m venv .venv
./.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt

2. Start the server

cd webapp
./.venv/bin/python app.py

Leave this terminal open. You should see:

 * Running on http://127.0.0.1:5000

3. Open in a browser

Go to http://127.0.0.1:5000 — it redirects to the methodology guide, and the sidebar links to every note. Stop the server anytime with Ctrl+C.

Troubleshooting

Symptom Fix
ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED The server isn't running — start app.py first and keep the terminal open.
Port 5000 already in use (macOS AirPlay) Change port=5000 in webapp/app.py to e.g. 8000, then open 127.0.0.1:8000. Or disable AirPlay Receiver in System Settings.
ModuleNotFoundError Run with the venv python: ./.venv/bin/python app.py (not bare python).

Notes on HTB/samples/

The files under HTB/samples/ are derived from a third-party public writeup (originally by svachal / @7h3rAm) and were kept as a format reference. HTB/Lame.md and HTB/Legacy.md are original notes. If you want a repo with no third-party-derived content, delete the samples/ folder.
